entities.name: Derive a declared reachability analysis receipt
entities.summary: Compute one bounded content-addressed closure over an explicit closed dependency graph whose subjects are present in a captured semantic-store projection.

acceptance: Every declared graph subject is present in one captured semantic-store projection
Closure and complement are exact for chains, branches, islands, and cycles
Graph and receipt identities are deterministic and permutation invariant
Malformed, duplicate, foreign, and over-limit inputs fail through typed errors
The receipt does not claim compiler-derived dependency authority

relations.summary: Reachability is computed over one immutable projection of semantic identities warranted by the accepted store.
The receipt establishes the first explicit compiler analysis relation without claiming dependency extraction.
